name: manual_dd2625
claim: OpenClaw env.shellEnv import brings the whole login-shell environment into the gateway, including keys the operator ruled out; reference provider keys by their real variable name, because a shell alias like WANDB_API_KEY with a dollar-brace value reaches the gateway unexpanded.

decisions.notes: Observed 2026-11-26: models status showed the W&B key as an unexpanded literal until the provider pointed at DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_WANDB directly; a direct status-only call with that key returned 200 at high effort.

rationale: Observed 2026-11-26: models status showed the W&B key as an unexpanded literal until the provider pointed at DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_WANDB directly; a direct status-only call with that key returned 200 at high effort.
